audience: employees who log their own hours in ClickTime, and managers who review team time

useCases.title: Review last week's logged hours
useCases.text: List your time entries for a date range, with job and task. Check the timesheet that covers those days for its status and total hours.

useCases.title: Log time on a job
useCases.text: Find the job and task ids, then log hours for a date with a comment. Confirm the date, hours and job with the user first.

useCases.title: Correct a time entry
useCases.text: Read one time entry, then change its hours, comment or times. Only the fields you pass change, and the date stays the same.

useCases.title: Submit a timesheet for approval
useCases.text: Check the actions available on the timesheet for a date, then submit it. Submitting locks the entries and notifies the approver.

useCases.title: Summarize company hours per job
useCases.text: With a Manager or Admin token, group hours and billings by job, user or month for a period.

useCases.title: Check time off balances
useCases.text: List the time off types with their current balances, and the time off you have taken or booked.
